claim: If the ECS agent on ECS Anywhere on-premises compute loses network connectivity to the in-Region ECS control plane, existing tasks continue to run; if tasks still have connectivity with other AWS services, they continue to communicate with them for as long as the task role credentials are active (the default expiration time is 6 hours), and once the credentials expire, tasks cannot communicate with other AWS services until connectivity with the control plane is re-established.

qualifiers.scope: task role credentials of Amazon ECS Anywhere tasks

evidence.quote: In the event of a loss of network connectivity between the ECS agent running on the on-premises compute and the in-region ECS control plane, existing ECS tasks will continue to run as usual. If tasks still have connectivity with other AWS services, they will continue to communicate with them for as long as the task role credentials are active (the default expiration time is 6 hours).

Once the credentials expire, tasks will not be able to communicate with other AWS services until the network connectivity with the control plane has been re-established, which will automatically renew the credentials.
